lessons.trigger_condition: The main learning/update path no longer requires Colab or Drive, but a tablet that previously ran TABLET_GDRIVE_SYNC_INSTALL.sh can retain 08:00/20:00 cron and Termux:Boot launchers outside the repository.
lessons.prevention_rule: Provide one bounded local-only command that removes only the known TABLET_GDRIVE_SYNC.sh cron line and the two known Drive boot launchers while preserving GitHub main update, 23:00 local learning, Drive files, and rclone account/configuration.
validation_required: bash main local-only and bash main cloud-off select the bounded cleanup path
cleanup filters only cron lines containing TABLET_GDRIVE_SYNC.sh
cleanup does not invoke rclone, remote deletion, pkill, or arbitrary process termination
tablet-only learning and daily 23:00 local scheduler remain unchanged
lessons.safety_boundary: No Drive content, rclone configuration, OAuth credential, unrelated cron line, unrelated boot script, grading data, market data, or GitHub update schedule is deleted.
